Presenting “Mallepoola Pallaki” Lyrical Video Song, featuring Ravi Teja and the soulful music of GV Prakash Kumar.
With vocals and musical energy by Dappu Srinu, lyrics by Chowdam Srinivasa , and the vibrant essence of Irumudi, this song brings together an energetic and captivating musical experience.
Enjoy the lyrical beauty, powerful beats, and infectious vibe of Mallepoola Pallaki!
